title: What Is Carpal Tunnel Surgery?
description: What carpal tunnel surgery (carpal tunnel release) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It releases the median nerve compressed at the wrist, which causes tingling, pain and weakness in the hand. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It releases the median nerve compressed at the wrist, which causes tingling, pain and weakness in the hand.

How is it done?

The ligament is cut, using an open or endoscopic technique, to decompress the nerve.

When is it indicated?

Carpal tunnel syndrome that does not improve with conservative treatment or that involves a deficit. The specialist decides.
